note: Codex imagegen was out of quota (2026-10-30), so the sprites are drawn by art/cat/build.py. The prompt below is the prepared one for a future codex redraw: attach assets/sprites/default.png and lead.png, then python art/snap.py sheet + sprite with a common scale (walk height 21 px).
prompt: Create ONE pixel-art sprite sheet image of an office cat named Cheese: an orange tabby cat (orange fur with darker orange stripes, cream belly/muzzle, pink nose), cute chibi proportions, same pixel-art style as the attached reference characters: 16-bit era, strict pixel grid, 1-pixel dark outline, flat 2-3 tone shading, about 16 colors, no anti-aliasing, no shadow, no text. All poses face RIGHT in side view and are drawn at the SAME scale (the cat is roughly 40 px long and 22 px tall when standing, if the attached human is 64 px tall). One single row of 5 poses left to right with wide gaps, each on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background (do not use magenta in the cat): 1. WALK frame 1: walking, front-right paw and back-left paw forward, other two legs back, legs clearly spread apart in a diagonal stride, tail up in an S curve. 2. WALK frame 2: the opposite stride, legs crossed over the other phase (the previously forward legs now back, the back legs now forward), same body. 3. SIT: sitting upright on its haunches, front legs straight, tail curled around the feet, head looking right, facing slightly toward the viewer. 4. SLEEP: curled up asleep in a round loaf, head tucked on paws, eyes closed, tail wrapped around. 5. HELD: lifted by the scruff of the neck (hand not shown), body hanging, all four legs dangling and flailing, tail hanging, wide-eyed annoyed face. Save the final image as sheet.png in the current directory.
